# Project Kickoff

## Overview

The Project Kickoff meeting was held on June 15, 2026, to establish the foundational vision and goals for developing open-source [hardware](./hardware.md) tailored for gardeners who prioritize data ownership.

## Key Details

- **Date:** June 15, 2026
- **Product Name:** [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md)
- **Product Description:** A soil moisture and temperature sensor.
- **Connectivity:** Uses MeshSync to extend wireless range.
- **Microcontroller (MCU):** nRF52840
- **Battery Target:** 18 months

## Related Entities

- **Nova Widget:** The core hardware product being developed for soil monitoring.
- **MeshSync:** The [networking](./networking.md) technology utilized for extending device range.
- **nRF52840:** The selected microcontroller unit (MCU) powering the Nova Widget.

## Related Concepts

- **Open [Sensors](./sensors.md):** The overarching philosophy and product category focusing on hardware accessibility and gardener data ownership.
- **Data Ownership:** Empowering users to retain complete control over their environmental sensor data.
